'''Grondarle''' was a [[Senior Commander/Legends|Senior Commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Grondarle served as [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Calo Drusan]]. When Lord [[Odo]] was aboard the ''Chimera'', pretending to carry out a mission for the Empire, he inquired about the purpose of the mission.<ref name="Choices of One" />
